requirements.description: A university student residence needs schools and universities nearby. Set at the 75th percentile (75.14, rounded to 75) of the education distribution because the use case implies a strong need for convenient access to university facilities.
The user explicitly requires a gross floor area of at least 850 sqm.

Energy class C or better (A1, A2, A3, A4, B, C). Location (Turin), gross floor area (>= 850 sqm), capacity (60 people), and the CDP/PNRR funding program are not energy-efficiency filterable columns and were not applied.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 850 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND education >= 75 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters on property type (office and similar), surface area of at least 850, energy class A1 to C, education proximity score of at least 75, and a 3.0 km radius around the supplied coordinates. Results are ordered by distance from that point. Capacity and funding program are not in the extracted requirements, so they are not filtered.
